summary: Retest of iteration_8 fixes on the public preview URL (390x844) + backend regression. Backend: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py 7/7 PASS (health advisor_ready:true/digest_ready:false, advisor SSE frames, digest 503/422). FIX#1 (autoProtectStreak) VERIFIED: seeded mtp_mock_matches_v1 with matches at today and today-3 for u_player plus tokens=3, reloaded -> mtp_freeze_tokens_v1 became {tokens:1, autoConsumed:['<yesterday>','<2-days-ago>']}; second/third reload did NOT double-spend (idempotent); with the default fresh state (tokens:1) exactly one gap day is frozen. FIX#2 (freeze-spent-note) VERIFIED: element present with text '(shield) Auto-protected / 2 rest days', persists across page reloads (read from persisted autoConsumed) and is correctly absent when no spend exists (today+yesterday, tokens untouched at 3). FIX#3 VERIFIED by code read: TrackerPage advisorContext now only has session_id, my_name, opponent_name, my_strengths, opponent_notes - no currentScore/currentGame references anywhere. FIX#4 VERIFIED: DashboardPage wraps logDates/protection/tokenState/streak in useMemo, no impure-render/React warnings (only pre-existing react-router v7 future-flag warnings). REGRESSION PASS: fresh login token vault = 3 slots with 1 filled + '1 freeze token / Next in 7 days'; achievements-reel with 5 tiles, ach-rank-climber opens share-badge-modal with 1080x1920 preview, Share/Save/close testids present; /profile digest-pending-state present and digest-send-now-btn absent. Zero console errors in every flow. Also ran a Node harness (/app/test_reports/streak_tokens_node_test.mjs) over 7 seed permutations of the real streakTokens.js + streaks.js - it exposed 2 remaining behavioural problems (streak count does not include protected days; tokens are burned on gaps that cannot be bridged).

minor.issue: Still open from iteration_8: SSE token frames are emitted as `data: {token}` without escaping embedded newlines; a token containing \n splits the frame.
Advisor payload now carries no score/serving state at all (FIX#3 removed the dead fields instead of wiring real ones), so tips cannot be situation-aware. Product decision needed.

ui_bugs.issue: MEDIUM: after auto-protection the displayed streak does NOT include the protected days. Seed today + today-3 with 3 tokens -> yesterday and 2-days-ago are frozen and the note says 'Auto-protected 2 rest days', but the card reads '2 DAY STREAK' (only the 2 logged days) instead of the expected 4. computeStreak only increments `current` for loggedSet days (`if (loggedSet.has(cursor)) current += 1;`) while frozen days merely bridge. Either count frozen/protected days in `current` (spec expectation from the review request) or change the UX copy so users understand a spent token does not grow the number.

MEDIUM (new): tokens are spent on gaps that cannot possibly be bridged, i.e. wasted currency. (a) Single log 5 days ago, today unlogged, 3 tokens -> spends ALL 3 tokens on -1/-2/-3 while the streak only reaches 1; this is the 'trailing inactivity' case the function's own docstring says it must NOT touch (the oldestAnchor is behind the gap, but there is no *later* logged day, so the gap is not bounded on the recent side). (b) today + today-10 with 3 tokens -> spends all 3 on -1/-2/-3, gap still broken at -4, streak stays 1 and 3 tokens are gone. Guard: only spend when the whole gap between the two anchors is coverable by the available tokens, and require a logged day on the recent side of the gap.
LOW: rank chip renders a doubled hash - 'Rank ##180' (literal '#' plus an already-prefixed value).
LOW: uses the raw browser date input (mm/dd/yyyy native picker) instead of the shadcn calendar/date-picker used elsewhere; inconsistent and poor on mobile.
LOW (carried over): TrackerPage still has no data-testid attributes on the setup form inputs, Start Match button or tab triggers.

The note claims '2 rest days' protected while the big number stays at 2 - visually contradictory to a user (see MEDIUM streak-count issue).

action_items: Decide + implement streak semantics: should auto-protected (frozen) days count toward streak.current? Review request expected a 4-day streak; the app shows 2.
MEDIUM: stop autoProtectStreak from burning tokens on un-bridgeable gaps (single old log / gap larger than available tokens).
LOW: fix 'Rank ##180' double hash on ProfilePage.
LOW: replace native date input in the Streak Freeze card with the shadcn date picker.
LOW: escape newlines in advisor SSE frames; add data-testids to TrackerPage.
Consider whether the advisor should receive live score/serving context (FIX#3 removed the fields rather than wiring them).
critical_code_review_comments: autoProtectStreak spends tokens greedily inside the loop before knowing whether the whole gap can be covered; move to a two-pass approach (collect gap days between two *logged* anchors, spend only if gapDays <= tokens).
computeStreak counts only logged days while the freeze feature markets 'protected rest days' - the two modules disagree on what a streak is; unify the definition in one place.
localStorage writes still happen inside useMemo (a render-phase hook). It is idempotent today, but React may discard/re-run memos; an effect is the correct home for the persistence side-effect.
DashboardPage.jsx is still ~800 lines; StreakCard/FormBars belong in src/components/.

success_rate.frontend: All 4 targeted fixes (autoProtectStreak, freeze-spent-note, advisorContext, useMemo purity) verified PASS; all iteration_8 regressions PASS; 2 new MEDIUM logic issues found (streak count excludes protected days, tokens wasted on un-bridgeable gaps)

rca_of_the_issue: The two remaining problems are semantic, not crashes. (1) autoProtectStreak's spend loop uses only the OLDEST logged/frozen day in the 14-day window as a boundary and spends a token on every missed day walking back from yesterday until tokens run out; it never checks that a logged day exists on the *recent* side of the gap nor that the gap fits inside the token budget, so with a single stale log (or a 10-day gap) it drains the vault for no streak gain. (2) computeStreak increments current only for loggedSet members, so frozen days bridge but never add to the count - hence 'today + today-3 with both gap days frozen' displays 2, not the 4 the review request expected.
